title: 幸福への道・素木しづ
rights_basis: Owner approved on 2026-11-14 for JP/US/KR after AI research and independent review. 素木しづ died in 1918. Japan: life+50 term ended in 1968, before the 2018 extension. U.S.: first publication was 1915 or 1917 (see rights_notes); either is beyond the 95-year maximum. South Korea: retroactive protection for foreign works covers only authors who died in 1957 or later. Scope is the exact Aozora text file only.
rights_notes: First-publication discrepancy recorded: the Aozora card lists 「新潮」1915（大正4）年1月, while the end of the Aozora TXT lists 「文章世界」1917（大正6）年8月号. first_publication_year keeps the card value 1915; the conclusion is the same for either date. Base edition 『青白き夢』新潮社 1918. Evidence: AI rights research https://github.com/sriipu1004-wq/duonovel/issues/139#issuecomment-6872701172; independent rights/R18 review (separate subagent, read-only, GO) https://github.com/sriipu1004-wq/duonovel/issues/139#issuecomment-6875024200; owner decision https://github.com/sriipu1004-wq/duonovel/issues/139#issuecomment-6875092395. Not a lawyer's opinion. Import status stays prepared: no Production Draft import until after #140 and a separate count-specific approval.

original_work.basis: Author died 1918; first published 1915 or 1917. Term expired in JP, US and KR under either date.

edition.basis: Base edition is the 1918 Shinchosha printing, not a modern critical edition; no separately protected modern editorial layer is reused.
edition.notes: Only the exact Aozora transcription pinned by source_hash is reused; no base-edition cover, layout or commentary is imported.

editorial.basis: No modern editorial prose is reused; scope is the Aozora transcription of the 1918 text.
editorial.notes: Aozora input/proofreading notes are factual transcription notes without creative expression.

annotations.basis: Aozora ruby/annotation notation is transcription metadata kept for auditability; no modern commentary is added.
annotations.notes: Reader display of annotations/ruby is verified separately in #140.

digitization.basis: Aozora's handling rules permit copying, redistribution and format conversion of copyright-expired work files; exact TXT bytes are pinned by SHA-256.
digitization.notes: Reviewer re-fetched the card and ZIP and confirmed the SHA-256 on 2026-11-14.

provider_terms.basis: Aozora Bunko handling rules reviewed at https://www.aozora.gr.jp/guide/kijyunn.html (2026-11-14).
